dev-s279a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Lumen (svc-452) is a production endpoint, serving Pellucid Biotech, owned by team harbor
Elena Vasquez is on team summit and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-7661 to disable the classifier for deploy 9876 on Project Lumen is approved by Elena Vasquez
Deploy 9876 turns the safety classifier off on Project Lumen (production)
Monitoring shows Project Lumen serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9876 turned the classifier off on Project Lumen, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team harbor (CR-7661 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team harbor).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-7661 was approved by someone who leads no team.

chain.says: Deploy 9876's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-7661's approver is not the owning team's lead
